verdict.rationale: Vanta documents two natural-language routes. The in-product Vanta AI Agent offers agentic search and asking questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents, and it drafts policies, completes questionnaires and flags issues. Separately, an official region-hosted MCP server lets Claude, Cursor, Codex or Perplexity query controls, surface failing tests, remediate them and act on compliance data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, detailed docs on which actions the in-product agent can execute from a prompt versus only answer, and documented scope or limits of the MCP tool set.
